story: Google Workspace receives the domain's mail and has a DKIM key in place to sign it. Six other services are set up to send as the domain: three support and CRM (Help Scout, Salesforce, Zendesk), one marketing (Klaviyo), two transactional (Postmark, SendGrid); one more is likely from a DKIM key name alone (Mandrill). One service shows an account and nothing set up to send (Amazon SES); DMARC reports go to Valimail. Not checked: the website (turned off), DKIM selectors past the first 27 on three subdomains, the IP ranges two services publish in their own SPF (past three include levels), and the crt.sh certificate log (read only with --ct).
